theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_pushforward_homotopy
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X r)) → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass) → ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ (push : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (homot : ∀ k : ℕ, (Euclid P → Euclid P) → (Euclid P → Euclid P) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → push k (fun x => x) X = X) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → Y ω = 0) → push k F (X - Y) = push k F X - push k F Y ∧ homot k F G (X - Y) = homot k F G X - homot k F G Y) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G F' G' : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → LipschitzWith Λ F' → LipschitzWith Λ G' → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → EqOn F F' E → EqOn G G' E → push k F X = push k F' X ∧ homot k F G X = homot k F' G' X) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (E) → X ω = 0) → IsIntegerMultiplicity (push k F X) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (homot k F G X) ∧ (push k F X).mass ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * X.mass ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F '' E) → push k F X ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1))) ({y : Euclid P | ∃ x ∈ E, ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, y = F x + t • (G x - F x)}) → homot k F G X ω = 0) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ E, dist (F x) (G x) ≤ δ) → (homot k F G X).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ * (2 * (Λ : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ k * X.mass) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact E → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1))) (E) → X ω = 0) → (push (k + 1) F X).boundary = push k F X.boundary ∧ push (k + 1) G X - push (k + 1) F X - homot k F G X.boundary = (homot (k + 1) F G X).boundary
